# Resistance Labs

> Independent software studio building local-first knowledge systems and calm social platforms.

- Canonical URL: https://resistancelabs.tech/
- Founded: January 2026
- Headquarters: Amman, Jordan
- Structure: Bootstrapped Software Studio
- Founder & Lead Engineer: Abdallah Arabi (abdallah@resistancelabs.tech)
- Contact: founders@resistancelabs.tech

---

## Executive Summary

Resistance Labs is an independent software studio building commercial tools for knowledge workers, researchers, and intentional communities. We design applications centered on local-first data ownership, bounded operating sessions, and private intelligence.

---

## Active Product Portfolio

### 1. ATLAS:Face
- Category: Personal Knowledge System (PKS) & Spatial Reader
- Status: Production Release v1.0.32
- Platforms: Windows (.exe), macOS (.dmg), Linux (.AppImage, .deb)
- Live Portal: https://atlasface.resistancelabs.tech/
- Commercial Editions & Licensing:
  - Core Edition ($0 / forever): Complete offline desktop sovereignty, unlimited local SQLite/Markdown notes, 3D spatial knowledge graph, native PDF/EPUB reader.
  - ATLAS Pro ($12 / month): Access to AI Features powered by Claude (multi-document semantic literature synthesis, automated active recall deck generation from reading highlights, contextual margin Q&A across local libraries, and encrypted cross-device cloud sync). Subscribed directly inside native desktop application.
- Core Capabilities: 3D spatial knowledge graph, integrated active recall cards, local SQLite/Markdown storage, and Claude-powered literature synthesis.

### 2. Suntown
- Category: Moderated Daily Social Room & Community Network
- Status: Live in Production
- Platform: Progressive Web Application (PWA)
- Live Portal: https://suntown.town/
- Public About Page: https://suntown.town/about/
- Operating Cadence: 4-hour daily Golden Hour ritual (14:00–18:00 UTC), closing completely outside the window.
- Commercial Sustainability & Revenue Model:
  - Community Citizen ($0): Daily 4-hour Golden Hour room access via Claude admissions evaluation.
  - Sustaining Townsfolk ($8 / month): Verified member seal, priority admissions intake queue, full writing archive exports (Markdown/JSON), and retrospective reading digests.
  - Hosted Private Guild ($49 / month / room): Dedicated time-bounded rooms for remote engineering teams and research labs, configurable ritual hours, and Claude-assisted weekly discussion synthesis.
- AI Integration: Uses Claude models to evaluate prospective member application responses against community standards and writing commitments prior to admission.

### 3. Developer & Focus Utilities
- RL-01 Latch: Desktop workspace commitment tool for uninterrupted deep work.
- RL-02 Reclaim: PWA inhibitory focus training with calibrated brown-noise acoustic masking.
- RL-03 Resistor Mark: Avatar generator for intentional digital focus (https://resistancelabs.tech/generator.html).

---

## Technical & AI Architecture

1. **Member Admissions Screening (Claude Models)**:
   In Suntown, prospective members submit written responses that are evaluated using Claude models to determine whether applicants understand community customs and meet the requirements to participate in the town.

2. **Semantic Knowledge Synthesis & Recall Generation (Claude Models)**:
   In ATLAS:Face, high-capacity contextual reasoning parses full-length books (EPUBs) and academic papers (PDFs) to build conceptual connections across personal research and generate active recall study decks.

3. **Unit Economics & High Gross Margins**:
   Local-first client storage keeps baseline infrastructure costs near zero, giving ATLAS:Face 90%+ software margins. Cloud and token consumption scales directly with paid ATLAS Pro subscribers ($12/mo) using Claude for semantic synthesis and recall generation.

4. **Local-First & Data Privacy**:
   No third-party ad networks, no telemetry auctions, and no training on user personal notes. User data lives on local disk in standard SQLite and Markdown formats.
